jobs.company: Community Youth Center of San Francisco
jobs.title: Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers
jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**

The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.  
  
**Title:****Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers**

**Salary:****$30.00 - $34.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full-Time, (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt**  
  
**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16-24. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  
  
**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Young Adult Job Center portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.  
  
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Cultivate relationships with employers, developing jobs for youth and young adults.
* Support agency-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination and development.
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs

CYC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other basis recognized by federal, state, or local law, including on the basis of the intersection of two or more protected characteristics, also known as intersectional discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

jobs.title: Program Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
WestCoast Children's Clinic, located in Oakland, California, is a non-profit community psychology clinic that provides mental health services to Bay Area children, youth and families. ***Working at WestCoast Children's Clinic means being part of an organization that is client-centered, trauma-informed, collaborative, and committed to justice and equity.***

**Position Details**

**Title**: Outpatient Program Care Coordinator

**Classification**: Regular Full Time (1.0 FTE), Non-exempt (Hourly)

**Location**: Oakland, CA / Hybrid (availability to provide client services in-person and complete documentation remotely)

**Regular Work Schedule**: Full time, M-F

**Compensation:**

* $34.62 per hour (plus additional 10% Spanish language differential for qualified candidates)

The **Program Care Coordinator** connects clients who have completed their initial referral screening to an Outpatient Program care team. Utilizing a trauma-informed and strengths-based approach, this role ensures that clients and families have the space, resources, access, and advocacy needed to amplify their own voice and choice in pursuing the level of care they deserve.

The **Program Care Coordinator** facilitates initial scheduling, connecting clients to treatment teams, monitoring follow-up, and provides immediate case management to support waitlisted clients until team assignment. The position engages internal and external providers to champion team-based care practices across service phases. The ideal candidate brings flexibility, organization, initiative, creativity, and an inclusive approach, backed by deep knowledge of the unique challenges facing children and families, especially those involved in foster care.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Track and manage youth referrals across electronic health records, spreadsheets, and Google Workspace.
* Provide short-term case management and care coordination for waitlisted youth, complete risk assessments and provide immediate crisis resources.
* Obtain clinical documentation (ROIs, past assessments) to inform care planning.
* Organize and facilitate program orientations for new referrals.
* Conduct proactive outreach to re-engage disengaged clients and connect them to care.
* Serve as a backup Child & Family Team (CFT) Meeting facilitator.
* Review CFT Care Plans to ensure state regulatory compliance.
* Complete compliant Medi-Cal documentation within 48 hours of service.
* Monitor client feedback to drive continuous program improvement.
* Cultivate and strengthen strategic community partnerships, and plan/execute monthly community gatherings for participants and staff.
* Uphold agency mission, ethical standards, and mandated reporting obligations while consistently participate in supervision, team meetings, and professional development.

**Qualifications:**

* **Minimum educational requirements:** Bachelor's degree with relevant experience. Candidates with an Associate of Arts Degree with long-term relevant experience may be considered.
* Experience facilitating events, team meetings and/or trainings.
* Ability to assess needs, strengths & provide crisis intervention and de-escalation,
* Passionate about working with young adults who have experienced complex trauma.
* Strong organizational, written & communication skills.
* Values working on a team, cultural humility, compassion, inclusivity, self-reflection, ongoing personal growth, self-care and social justice.

**Competencies:**

* Demonstrated experience working with transitional age youth (TAY) and families who may be involved in the child welfare system.
* Ability to work with clients who have complex traumatic histories and other attachment difficulties.
* **Cultural Humility** - Knowledge of issues of race, class and ethnicity.
* **Efficiency and Time Management** - Ability to be well-organized and complete timely documentation.
* **Collaboration and Team Functioning** - Ablility to work independently and collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team.

### ***Why work here?***

* **Be part of a compassionate, driven team that is social justice-focused:** We have Staff Affinity Groups such as Staff of Color, LGBTQ+, Equity and Inclusion, Health and Wellness, and more!

* **Make a difference for the Bay Area's most vulnerable populations:** We serve hundreds of vulnerable kids and their families each year to create positive changes in their lives!

* **Access a growth-oriented learning community:** As a Joint Commission Accredited agency, we are dedicated to providing the highest standard of care, and offer extensive clinical trainings and seminars led by field experts.

### **Benefits:**

* Employer-paid Medical Benefits for Employees
  + 100% employer-paid dental and vision
  + Dependent medical, dental and vision (50% employer-paid)
* Medical and Dependent Care FSA and commuter plans
* 100% employer-paid life insurance long-term disability insurance
* Voluntary accident, term life and hospital indemnity insurance
* 403(b) and ROTH retirement plan options, employer contribution targeted at 7.5% after first year of employment
* Quarterly (5-10%) and annual incentive compensation (10%)
* Three weeks PTO during the first year of employment, 4+ weeks PTO with additional years of service
* 12 paid holidays plus one paid floating holiday per year
* 4 paid self-care days per year
* Wellness stipend ($100.00 per month)
* Professional development stipend and CEUs for trainings
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

***Join us and make a difference in the lives of vulnerable children and families in the Bay Area.***

jobs.company: California Association of Public Hospitals and Health Systems
jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The California Health Care Safety Net Institute (SNI) partners with California’s public health care systems to optimize and transform the ecosystem of care, providing high-quality, patient-led, and equitable care for all. Together with our advocacy partner, the California Association of Public Hospitals and Health Systems, SNI works to strengthen care delivery systems by shaping the policies and programs that drive improvement and creating a community where system leaders can exchange ideas and advance shared priorities.

SNI and CAPH represent California’s 17 public health care systems, which include the county-owned or affiliated systems and the University of California academic medical centers. These systems serve as the foundation of the state’s safety net, delivering care to all who need it, regardless of insurance coverage, immigration status, ability to pay, or other circumstances. Public health care systems primarily serve people from historically marginalized communities, including persons of color, individuals experiencing financial hardship or homelessness, and individuals with complex health and social needs.

Although SNI and CAPH are separate legal entities, they function day-to-day as a matrix organization, with SNI contributing to CAPH’s policy and advocacy efforts, CAPH offering technical expertise to SNI’s programs, and the organizations working together to achieve shared goals for our member systems.

SNI and CAPH are committed to advancing equity and serve as an Equal Opportunity Employer with a strong commitment to racial, cultural, and ethnic diversity. Qualified applicants of all races, people with all abilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply.

**SNI’s Programs**

SNI brings together systems’ leaders from clinical, quality, data, finance, and operational areas through in-person and virtual convenings, communities of practice, webinars, and our CAPH/SNI Annual Conference. By creating a community where leaders can exchange ideas and problem-solve, SNI helps systems work through complex issues and apply successful strategies from peers in their own settings.

Beyond these convenings, SNI creates practical resources and content to surface and share what is working across the field. These include lessons learned briefs, roadmaps, case studies, and articles drawn from member systems’ experiences.

**Position Summary and Primary Responsibilities**

The Program Coordinator plays an essential support role in planning and implementing SNI’s programs. Working closely with SNI and CAPH staff, the Coordinator will:

· Support the design and delivery of in-person and virtual learning events for health system leaders across SNI’s program areas (e.g., protecting Medicaid coverage and access, strengthening health equity, improving cost effectiveness and efficiency).

o Coordinate end-to-end event logistics, including developing and managing workplans, scheduling speaker prep calls, creating and administering pre-event surveys and post-event evaluations, and providing day-of support during events, among other duties.

o Work with the program team, particularly the team lead, to identify systems’ needs and develop program content and materials.

· Lead the Quality Leaders Awards ceremony and luncheon during CAPH/SNI’s Annual Conference.

o Prepare and disseminate the call for applications and organize submissions.

o Coordinate the judging process by helping to identify external judges, scheduling judging calls, and reviewing and scoring submissions with the judges’ panel.

o Oversee the awards ceremony and luncheon at the annual conference, including serving as the point of contact for awardees, preparing the SNI Board Chair to moderate, and managing all aspects of the day-of event, among other duties.

o Additionally, support the annual conference team in identifying and preparing conference speakers.

· Perform administrative duties, such as scheduling meetings, summarizing meeting notes, and printing and compiling meeting materials.

· Complete other duties and projects as needed.

**Required Knowledge and Experience**

· Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a health-related field, or commensurate experience.

· Minimum of 1 year of work experience, which may include internships and fellowships. Experience working in a health care setting and/or public agency a plus.

· Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects in a timely, organized manner with .

· Strong writing and editing skills. Adept at translating complex information into accessible language for a variety of audiences.

· Fluent in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Zoom. Preferred experience working with WordPress, Constant Contact, and/or online collaborative tools, such as Miro.

· Comfortable using AI tools to improve work quality and productivity while exercising independent thinking and ownership of final work.

· Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and ability to interact professionally and courteously with health system leadership, consultants, and peers.

· Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn on the fly, and work effectively in teams, as well as independently.

· Understanding of California’s health care landscape, particularly programs that serve Medicaid and uninsured patients, a plus.

**Work Environment**

CAPH/SNI operates in a hybrid work environment, with two required in-person days (Monday and Wednesday) at the office in Oakland, CA for those living 40 miles or less from the office; one required in-person day (Monday) for those living farther away. The remaining days are conducted remotely.

This role requires occasional in-state travel, including overnight travel for in-person convenings and the annual conference.

The starting salary range for this position is $65,000-$75,000. SNI offers an extremely competitive benefits package, as well as opportunities to attend professional conferences and participate in professional development trainings.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Vector Atomic:**

Vector Atomic, an IonQ company, is building quantum technology to transform navigation, timing, geophysical exploration, and telecommunications. Our team of engineers, scientists, software developers, and operations professionals works together to solve complex challenges and turn bold ideas into real-world solutions. We value collaboration, curiosity, and diverse perspectives, and we give every team member the opportunity to make an immediate impact while growing their skills. If you're excited to work on breakthrough technology in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we'd love to hear from you.

We are seeking a hands-on **Project Coordinator** to assist with project management and scheduling, as well as contract administration. To support challenging technical goals, you will take ownership of, and create streamlined processes for, management, tracking, and delivery of programmatic requirements. Working closely with executive leadership and the overall team, your responsibilities will include: (a) program support for Principal Investigators, including report creation and submission, project scheduling/tracking, and program management; (b) taking possession of contract review and administration; (c) distill and convey complex ideas to technical and general audiences; (d) adding structure and efficient processes to our organization while maintaining our get-it-done culture. The ideal candidate is unafraid to dive into new concepts, can handle and prioritize multiple tasks, and has broad experience generating high-quality written and presentation materials.
  
  
**Location: This role is based onsite at our office in Pleasanton, CA (Bay Area)**

 **Requirements**

**What You’ll Do**

* Work with a team of physicists and engineers to help synthesize and refine content for the target audience
* Create and edit content, including figures, images, and diagrams, for contract deliverables (e.g., monthly and/or quarterly reports – primarily PPT-based)
* Support kickoff, interim, and final review meetings through content creation/scheduling
* Provide scheduling/organization function via weekly deliverable tracker + Project Management software (Smartsheet and Jira)
* Participate in internal and external team calls/meetings/visits
* Contract review (flow down requirements/assist with revision requests/etc.) and tracking; distill and convey requirements to technical team
* Support accounting through creation/submission of invoices
* Contribute to final reports and proposals

**What We're Looking For:**

* To comply with the US export control laws, Vector Atomic employees must be U.S. citizens (born or naturalized), lawful U.S. permanent residents (i.e. green card holders), and certain categories of refugees, and asylees.
* Strong time management, organizational, problem-solving and analytical skills; able to manage priorities and workflow
* Ability to comb through and edit complex technical details and jargon
* Strong interpersonal skills; discuss/refine complex ideas; negotiate personalities/styles to achieve the best product
* Strong attention to detail; pride in work product
* Proactive; looks for opportunities to make the organization and their co-workers better
* Ability to prioritize, multitask, and deliver high quality work while managing multiple deadlines

 **Benefits**

Vector Atomic values teamwork, open and honest discourse, and work-life balance. We offer competitive compensation and benefits including:

* Platinum-level family health coverage (medical, dental, vision)
* Health and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Employer 401(k) contributions
* 20 days of paid time off & 11 paid holidays
* Paid parental leave
* Fully stocked kitchen

**Pay Range**

The approximate base salary range for this position is $80,000 to $120,000 per year. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity and benefits. It's atypical to be hired at the top end of this range for the role, as actual pay is based on several factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience level.

*Vector Atomic is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by law.*

*Vector Atomic does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.*

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**  
For over 40 years, 24 Hour Fitness has been a leader in the industry, driven by our mission to help our community live healthier and happier through the transformative power of fitness. With clubs nationwide, we create inclusive, welcoming spaces equipped with premium strength and cardio equipment, studio classes, and innovative digital tools. Our impact goes beyond the gym-we support our members' total well-being through coaching, connection, and community. Join us and be part of a team that's changing lives every day!

jobs.title: Automation Program Manager, Legal and Compliance Operations
jobs.description:
Legal and Compliance Operations is seeking an Automation Program Manager to help us automate high-volume review at scale across Legal and Compliance workflows. Our workflows run on a composite of LLM-based decisioning, rules-based logic that encodes policy directly, and signals drawn from reporter history, content matching and behavioral patterns. Automation now carries a substantial share of enforcement volume, which means its quality determines both the legal risk we mitigate and the experience of the rights holders, regulators and people who depend on these decisions.As an Automation Program Manager, you will own the measured quality of assigned automations. Half of the role is forward motion: taking an automation from where it performs today to where the operational plan requires, through iteration on prompts, rules and signal thresholds. The other half is regression response: when reliability, correctness, precision or recall degrades, you find out why and drive it back. An effective candidate in this role is rigorous about measurement, comfortable working across all three automation types, and able to tell a genuine regression apart from a shift in what is arriving.  
  
  

### **Automation Program Manager, Legal and Compliance Operations Responsibilities:**

* Hill-climb reliability (prompt, iterate and improve), correctness, precision and recall on assigned automations across Legal and Compliance Workflows

* Experience working with large operational datasets in a notebook environment
* Investigative approach to metric movement, identifying cause rather than the explanation that fits
* Experience communicating results clearly, including reporting a metric that has not moved or a regression that is not yet explained

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

---------------------

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee commercial construction projects, including tenant improvements, renovations, and specialized construction within the life sciences, healthcare, technology, and education sectors.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Under the general direction of the Director, Health Major Capital, the Senior Project Manager (Sr. PM) manages multiple capital projects ranging from $50,000 to $500 million, ensuring delivery on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with quality, operational, and program requirements. The Sr. PM provides project management services throughout the project lifecycle, with primary responsibility for equipment planning, furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E), procurement, operational readiness, activation, occupancy, and closeout.

The Sr. PM leads and coordinates multidisciplinary teams including architects, engineers, contractors, equipment vendors, furniture suppliers, Information Technology, Supply Chain, Facilities Management, clinical users, regulatory agencies, and other UCSF stakeholders. Responsibilities include developing and managing equipment budgets, procurement and activation plans, project schedules, vendor and consultant agreements, relocations, and occupancy readiness.

Representing UCSF Health as an owner's representative, the Sr. PM supports new construction, expansions, renovations, and retrofit projects. The Sr. PM reviews design documents for equipment infrastructure, utilities, operational functionality, infection prevention, phasing, and fire/life safety requirements and coordinates equipment installation and activation to minimize project risk and ensure operational readiness.

The Sr. PM maintains accurate project schedules, budgets, forecasts, procurement records, activation milestones, and reporting using internal project management systems. The role supports Capital Budget development and ensures documentation is complete for occupancy, activation, project closeout, audit readiness, and informed decision-making.

Working with a high degree of autonomy, the Sr. PM exercises independent judgment in managing medium- to large-scale projects of moderate to difficult complexity and may coordinate the work of other Project Managers and Assistant Project Managers.

**Key Skills**

* Develop and manage project, procurement, activation, occupancy, and close out schedules and budgets.
* Maintain budget projections, cash flow forecasts, project records, and timely reporting.
* Develop, administer, and monitor consultant, vendor, and procurement agreements.
* Manage risks related to scope, schedule, budget, procurement, equipment delivery, installation, and operational readiness.
* Review invoices, equipment purchases, and vendor payment requests for accuracy and completeness.
* Lead FF&E, medical equipment, IT, signage, relocation, move management, activation, and operational transition activities.
* Coordinate vendors, contractors, clinical departments, regulatory agencies, and UCSF support teams.
* Ensure required documentation and readiness activities are completed before occupancy and activation.
* Apply LEAN practices and identify opportunities to improve project delivery.
* Build strong relationships across UCSF and foster a collaborative culture of accountability, trust, and integrity.

Position will work at all UCSF Health locations throughout the San Francisco Bay Area, including new off-campus lease sites. All Real Estate staff are required to be on-site, in-person, no less than four full days per week, although project activities may require additional on-site presence. The PM is required to be responsive to project needs and demands throughout planning, procurement, activation, occupancy, and project closeout.

Services are provided through the following departments: Building Permit Services, Campus Design and Construction, Campus Planning, Construction Contract Administration, Health Design and Construction, Health Major Capital Projects, Real Estate Services, Benioff Children’s Hospital Oakland Capital Program Management and support through Business Intelligence, and Finance, Administration and Operations.

The Major Capital Project Department is responsible for delivering the design and construction of new buildings and other major capital projects as assigned. Typical project budgets are hundreds of millions of dollars. Our goals are delivered through Integrated Project Delivery (IPD) methodologies. Current project delivery methods include an IFOA contract. Our vision is to be recognized as an innovative and collaborative owner through new processes, innovation of new delivery models, contracts, and commercial terms that will attract the most qualified teams. Our projects are managed in the Integrated Center for Design and Construction (Big Room). Our work emphasizes the development of highly integrated and collaborative teamwork. We fully support and integrate Lean tools in our project work.

The combined UCSF Campus and Health organizations include approximately 198 UCSF and 38 contract personnel; operating/recharge budgets of more than $52.2M per year; current year capital project expenditures of $900 million; and oversight and responsibility for > $13.3 billion long-range capital development.

The Executive Premier Support Office (EPSO) is a newly established team within Uber’s Global Escalations organization, focused on delivering high-priority support to Uber’s most critical stakeholders. This includes high-impact teams (safety, fraud, comms, social media), high-vis partners such as the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), and other critical teams & leaders.  
  
We’re looking for a Global Program Manager to join this specialized team and assist in the management of time-sensitive and high-priority escalations. In this role, you will contribute to the full case lifecycle—from internal intake to external customer outreach to issue resolution and executive follow-up. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to drive fast, accurate solutions and help maintain a high bar for customer experience.  
  
As part of a global team, you will collaborate with stakeholders across multiple regions, particularly in US&C, EMEA, and APAC. This role requires strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to drive solutions for complex, high-stakes issues with discretion and clarity. You’ll represent the voice of the customer and ensure every escalation receives the urgency and professionalism it demands.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  
  

* Participate in a global on-call rotation to provide support outside standard business hours—including nights, weekends, and holidays.
* Assist in the management of high-priority escalations from intake through resolution, providing support for Uber’s most critical customers and internal stakeholders.
* Contribute to the case management process for EPSO, ensuring timely, high-quality outcomes and proactive communication across internal audiences.
* Skillfully communicate with diverse external audiences across platforms including phone, email, and chat.
* Support program and regional teams in aligning internal communications and root cause narratives with broader strategic objectives.
* Assist in the review and editing of resolution summaries to ensure they meet standards for clarity, accuracy, and tone—especially for ELT visibility.
* Contribute to operational continuity by supporting the review of actions taken by the EPSO team across all global shifts (24/7).
* Serve as a point of contact for internal inquiries during active escalations, helping to coordinate across functions and ensuring the swift engagement of the right teams.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Advocacy & Solutions, Engineering, Product, Legal, and Communications to help drive fast and effective resolution of complex, sensitive issues.
* Assist in the drafting and editing of post-resolution documentation, including executive-ready summaries and actionable next steps.
* Support team communications and recognition initiatives that help build the brand and internal identity of the EPSO team.
* Observe and report recurring themes and operational gaps, sharing insights to inform process improvements that increase efficiency and consistency across the team.
* Manage a team of support agents, taking ownership of their professional growth and operational success by establishing clear expectations and providing personalized coaching.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* 3+ years experience of operations, investment banking / consulting / business intelligence / strategy or related experience.
* 2+ years in coaching, developing, and leading a team
* Excel proficiency (modeling, data visualization) and/or working knowledge in applying SQL, Python, R, Stata or similar statistical language.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Operations, or a related discipline.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams across multiple time zones.
* Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) software or other customer support tools.
* Previous experience with on-call rotations or incident response in operational settings.
* Experience with sensitive and critical customer care escalations.
* High-growth operations or startup experience is strongly preferred.
* Strong business acumen, with experience evaluating a line of business holistically and understanding how to drive growth, both short and long-term
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, with experience managing cross functional partnerships and relationships.
* Data-Driven Mentality: Make strategic decisions based on data analysis and interpretation. Experience getting in the weeds of data, balanced with the ability to see the big picture.
* Communication: Demonstrated experience interpreting and presenting data to various audiences in an engaging and comprehensive, yet succinct manner
* Teamwork: Demonstrate optimism, respect others, and work well in a team. Ability to work with people from a diverse set of backgrounds and responsibilities. Maintains healthy working relationships, even in disagreement.
* Executional Excellence: Ability to optimally manage and prioritize complex operations that require the support of peers and other teams, and deliver results in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, while maintaining high-quality work standards.
* Planning & Organization: Ability to plan complex or multi-faceted projects with cross-functional teams, defining timelines, deliverables, interdependencies, and resource allocation.

  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $106,000 per year - USD $118,000 per year.

### **Company Description**

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

### **Job Description**

We have an opening for a **Research & Development (R&D) Radiation Generating Device (RGD) & Sealed Radioactive Source (SRS) Program Lead** within the Radiation Protection Functional Area. This position independently plans and executes Research and Development (R&D) efforts supporting the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of LLNL’s Radiation Generating Devices and Sealed Radioactive Source Safety programs. The RGD/SRS Program Lead works independently, with minimal direction, to plan and execute research and development (R&D) efforts within the context of applying science technological and R&D engineering to anticipate, innovate, and deliver program solutions to the Laboratory’s mission. This position is in the Environment, Safety and Health (ESH) Directorate, within the Radiological Protection Functional Area (RPFA).

*This position may offer a hybrid schedule, which includes the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week, after a probationary period. The specifics of the hybrid schedule, including the exact number of days required in the office and virtual work options may vary based on the needs of the team and the organization.*

This position is subject to DOE Order 426.2, *Personnel Selection, Training, Qualification, and Certification Requirements for DOE Nuclear Facilities*. This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

**You will**

* Set specific technical strategy and direction for the Radiation Generating Device and Sealed Radioactive Source Safety Programs, serving as the technical expert RGD, accelerators, and high activity sealed sources across LLNL and the Department of Energy (DOE) complex.
* Assist in the development of shielding and design verification in order to solve complex radiological source problems introduced by RGDs and high activity sealed radioactive sources requiring in-depth analysis of tangible and intangible factors, including regulatory requirements, program needs, and variable work environments.
* Provide radiological oversight during annual compliance surveys for High-Risk RGDs, verifying that administrative and engineering controls remain effective and identifying corrective actions where deficiencies are found.
* Develop radiological survey plans addressing non-uniform radiation fields produced by pulsed devices, accounting for the unique measurement and instrumentation considerations these fields present.
* Work independently, with minimal direction, using independent judgment to determine methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for RGD/SRS Safety Program design meeting requirements and expectations of DOE O 420.2E, 10 CFR 835, and DOE G 441.1C.
* May have latitude to establish program objectives and allocate assigned technical resources.
* Guide the completion of RGD/SRS Safety Program initiatives and contribute to RPFA's organizational goals, exerting significant influence on use and control of radiation generating devices and accountable sealed radioactive sources.
* Act as the primary technical contact for the RGD/SRS Safety Program, interacting with program staff, RGD Custodians, professional colleagues, internal management, and DOE representatives, and serve on internal and external technical committees and industry peer groups, including those focused on accelerator health physics.
* Lead technical portions of internal and external audits, inspections, and site verifications, including triennial audits and DOE oversight of RGDs and accelerator safety-program adequacy.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Additional job responsibilities, at the SES.4 level**

* Independently direct R&D technical tasks and RGD/SRS compliance activities such as annual radiation surveys, safety assessments, and semi-annual leak tests, setting broad program vision and technical strategy for the RGD/SRS Safety Program.
* Develop solutions to control highly complex radiological source terms produced by radiation generating devices and accelerators. These problems may require in-depth analysis of multiple tangible and intangible factors, and development of innovative methods and technologies that advance RGD/SRS Safety Program knowledge Laboratory-wide.
* Provide strategic technical support to RGD custodians establishing work processes involving RGDs, Accelerators, and High Activity radioactive sources.
* Work under consultative direction within the scope of the assignment, determining and pursuing courses of action essential to obtaining desired RGD/SRS program outcomes.
* Establish assignment objectives and allocate resources across multiple assigned program elements.
* Provide strategic technical input that supports the development, sustainment, and resourcing of the RGD/SRS Safety Program; may serve as an organizational spokesperson on significant RGD/SRS safety matters.

### **Qualifications**

* Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
* Bachelor’s degree in Health Physics, Nuclear Engineering, Radiation Physics, Radiation Protection, or a related STEM Field or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.
* Advanced knowledge of Operational and Technical Health Physi

Bring your talents to Ross, our leading off-price retail chain with over 2,200 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. Our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high-quality brands and on-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. All while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.

As part of our team, you will experience:

* **Success**. Our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving

* **Our commitment to Diversity, Equality & Inclusion, and our community.** We celebrate the backgrounds, identities, and ideas of those who work and shop with us because our differences make us stronger. We strive to be a positive force in our community.

jobs.description:
* San Jose, California, United States
* Sales
* Experienced Professionals
* 21975

  

**Relationships That Drive Results. Success That Lasts.**
---------------------------------------------------------

Our account managers serve as the go-to contact for our customers, embodying our purpose to make construction better by being their partner for productivity, safety, and sustainability. You will manage your own portfolio of customer accounts and be given ownership to build a work schedule that best suits you and your customers. You’ll make sales by maintaining customer relationships, demonstrating our latest tools on the spot, and providing high level customer consultation.

**What You'll do**
------------------

* Building relationships – you’ll meet with customers at a moment’s notice or be actively present to capture the perfect business opportunity. You understand to create value in account(s) through long-term, profitable relationships
* Time and Territory Management (TTM) - creating a daily schedule (including presence on jobsites and client offices) to optimize client potential and sales productivity by zone territory
* Be a Hilti Champion – you’ll carry the technical knowledge to present high level customer consultations in your defined territory and represent the Hilti brand in the marketplace
* Tracking your progress – you’ll utilize Salesforce to record all the interactions you had to make a sale as reporting is a key part of this role

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* High School Diploma or GED required
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred or equivalent work experience
* At least three years of outside sales experience – preferably in an environment with set targets
* Hands-on attitude – you'll be demonstrating our tools to our customers, using platforms such as Salesforce to keep track of everything, and collaborate with a variety of departments
* Maintain a valid driver’s license – we'll provide you with a company car, be sure you’re ready to drive
* Excellent time and territory management skills
* Must be able to walk on construction projects, climb scaffolding, and lift as much as 65 pounds at any given time
* Work a flexible and varied schedule

**What’s In It for You**
------------------------

Our strategic account managers earn between $103,000 – $113,000 + up to $24,000 in bonuses for their first year if all sales goals are met. The account manager role offers an uncapped bonus potential. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training.
  
  
We are committed to caring for our people, which is why our retention has been over 90% for the last five years. It’s why we haven’t gone through any waves of layoffs – even during the COVID-19 pandemic. We value development, which is why 80-90% of our roles are filled internally. It’s why most of our account managers come from a non-construction background.
  
Success at Hilti comes down to teamwork and ability – the Hilti culture is contagious, and we have an excellent mix of people who are always looking to help one another.
  
This job is #LI-Hybrid, meaning it is field-based and requires daily customer in-person interaction with your home serving as your office location.

**Why Hilti**
-------------

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

**Commitment to Inclusion**
---------------------------

At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

Hilti, Inc is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

  
  

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

  
  

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

  
  

**Account Manager/Specialty Account Manager – Tavneos**

  
  

**Live**

**What you will do**

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. We are seeking an Account Manager/Specialty Account Manager to complete commercial activities for the assigned geography and establish relationships with customers to drive demand for Tavneos (avacopan) in approved patients. Tavneos is indicated as an adjunctive treatment of adult patients with severe active anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic autoantibody (ANCA)-associated vasculitis (granulomatosis with polyangiitis [GPA] and microscopic polyangiitis [MPA]) in combination with standard therapy including glucocorticoids.

  
  

This role is field based and will require gaining access to customers in a clinic OR hospital setting while also enhancing your ability to engage through digital channels.

  
  

The RD AM/SAM will be responsible for product performance at a territory level, expected to be a disease category expert, a product champion, provide account management support, and exhibit business knowledge of the local landscape to assess key stakeholders plus future trends within the marketplace.

  
  

Responsibilities include:

* Proficiency in both live and virtual customer engagements
* Develop a comprehensive and effective territory business plan aimed at achieving and exceeding annual goals established by commercial leadership
* Ability to engage all partners around patient ecosystem – caregivers, HCPs, case managers, nurses, infusion centers, etc. in multiple settings of care-Hospital, Clinic, etc.
* Able to effectively collaborate across all corporate functions-MSLs, TLLs, Field Access Team, supporting sales teams, etc.
* Channel patients to treatment: Crafting referral networks to both existing centers of excellence, as well as, setting up new treatment CoEs.
* Building long-term relationships across multiple stakeholders and senior decision-makers, both inside and outside of Amgen, and sustaining extensive and rich networks to advance business partnerships and deep customer relationships.
* Ability to build broader disease awareness beyond the expert (i.e., with patients, GPs)
* Identifies drivers/barriers and coordinates pull-through initiatives across field teams
* Provides actionable field intelligence and recommendations to Amgen home office
* Partners closely with Market Access Team Account Executives in shared accounts.
* Promote Tavneos within approved labeling in a comprehensive, fair and ethical manner that is consistent with industry specific and corporate legal and regulatory guidelines
* Develop strong customer relationships by better understanding the customer’s needs
* Serves as a resource/consultant to customers and staff regarding payer policies and processes (eligibility and benefit verification, prior-authorization and appeals/denials)
* Improve use of marketing resources to maintain and develop customer relationships for the purpose of growing the customers’ confidence to prescribe Amgen medications for appropriate patients
* Communicates territory activity in an accurate and timely manner as directed by management
* Provides feedback to sales and commercial leadership, marketing colleagues, and other internal departments about changing environment and other internal departments
* Successfully completes all training classes
* Completes administrative duties in an accurate and timely fashion
* Manages efforts within assigned promotional budget
* Attends medical congresses and society meetings as needed
* Ensures timely access for patients through patient services and savings programs
  

  

**Win**

**What we expect of you**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Specialty Account Manager we seek is a motivated professional with these qualifications.

  
  

**Basic Qualifications (Account Manager – Level 4)**

* Bachelor's Degree and 3 years of sales experience within pharmaceutical, biotech or medical device industry or hospital sales experience OR
* Associate degree and 6 years of sales experience within pharmaceutical, biotech or medical device industry or hospital sales experience OR
* High school diploma/GED and 8 years of sales experience within pharmaceutical, biotech or medical device industry or hospital sales experience

* Doctorate degree & 2 years of collective account management experience, sales, & commercial experience OR

jobs.description:
Under the general direction of the Director, Health Major Capital Sr. Project Manager (Sr. PM) is accountable for project management services to ensure design and construction projects are on schedule, within budget, high-quality, cost-effective, and appropriate to client program needs. Simultaneously manages multiple projects of various sizes in the challenging healthcare construction environment. Services include all elements of project management from concept through project closeout including initial scoping, budgeting, funding, procurement, construction management and closeout of large and small projects.

The Sr. PM organizes, plans, and controls the design and construction efforts on projects ranging from $50,000 - $500,000,000. This involves selecting professional design staff (architects and engineers), general contractors and subcontractors, coordinating the activities of clients, construction inspectors, and others associated with the projects; managing project progress to achieve overall project objectives consistent with department standards and in alignment with customer expectations including, budget, cost and quality; resolving problems that arise in the projects; working with state agency officials to ensure compliance and safety. The project manager has a first line responsibility to communicate effectively with project stakeholders regarding program, budget, schedule, and construction impact. The Sr. PM utilizes internal project management tools and systems to monitor progress, control schedules and budgets, generate timely reports, and maintain comprehensive records throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure accurate data entry and updates to support transparent communication, audit readiness, and informed decision-making. Sr. PM provides support to the annual Capital Budget development process. Project managers may be responsible for coordinating the activities of other Project Managers and Assistant Project Managers as directed.

Represents UCSF Health on design and construction projects, including new development, facility expansion, renovations and retrofitting. Responsible for coordinating, monitoring and reporting on all design and construction activities. Administrate consultant and construction agreements, facilitate quality control, maintenance of design and construction schedules, construction management and owner representative responsibilities. Manage medium-to-large teams of external vendors and internal affiliate and service line staff on medium-to-large projects. Demonstrate a mastery of project management, works with a high degree of autonomy, and is responsible for delivering medium to large scale projects with moderate to difficult complexity. Responsible for delivering projects on time and on budget. Exercises independent judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.

Sr. PM leads developmental stage of capital projects to assure that project scope, schedule, and phasing are adequately defined. Use Major Capital project benchmarks and/or work with the design professionals to create the preliminary project budget and schedule.

Sr. PM defines working criteria for a proposed project, determining the hazardous materials, infection control, phasing of work, and fire and life safety requirements that are necessary. Estimate the design review efforts for a project to assure that the quality of the construction documents is sufficient to minimize the risk of cost overruns during construction.

  

Sr. PM coordinates the efforts of the Inspector of Record, state agencies (e.g., CDPH), the contractor and University representatives to ensure code compliance and quality of work, and a constructive relationship with the regulators. Prepare and verify that all required documentation is completed prior to occupancy or authorized approval of a project.

Sr. PM coordinates all project relocations, furniture, equipment and IT scopes of work, which may be supported by other internal UCSF Real Estate resources. Sr. PM is responsible to assure that all aspects of the project are addressed in a timely manner.

**Skills**

* Develop and maintain project schedules, resources and budgets.
* Maintain project schedule and budget projections for monthly cash flow reports.
* Develop, execute and monitor vendor contracts.
* Manage project risks associated with schedule, scope and budget.
* Review and approve invoices, including pay applications for accuracy and completeness.
* Develop, monitoring and completion of project closeout strategy.
* Maintain a strong team culture of accountability and integrity on the projects they manage.
* Identify gaps and work with supervisors to correct.
* Implement LEAN processes to ensure reliability in projects.
* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with affiliate representatives, management and other departments within UCSF.
* Ensure their teams maintain a culture of high collaboration, accountability, trust and integrity.
* Collaborate effectively with other Real Estate staff including but not limited to Assistant PMs, Project Manager Assistants, architects, signage and wayfinding manager, FFE coordinator, etc.

Position will work at all UCSF Health locations in San Francisco Bay Area including new off-campus lease sites. All Real Estate staff are required to be on-site, in-person, no less than 4 full days per week, although project activities may require beyond that requirement. The PM is required to be responsive to the project needs and demands based on the phases of the project and construction activities.

The organization of UCSF Real Estate is focused on the development, planning, delivery, and management of physical space for UCSF. Key responsibilities include a unified approach to oversee the active UCSF growth planned on a multi-site campus and to manage the complex metropolitan environments affecting capital assets and projects and efforts to align

**What you will do**

The Rare Disease Key Account Manager’s overall goal is to reduce time to diagnosis, increase appropriate patient identification and improve speed to treatment by partnering with key stakeholders in targeted accounts through focus in the therapeutic areas that Amgen's Rare Disease products are indicated. The Rare Disease Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for unlocking operational and access challenges related to appropriate therapies across assigned health systems, specialty clinics, infusion centers, and sites of care to grow the overall rare disease business in the assigned accounts and market. The KAM diagnoses account-level barriers and executes targeted strategies that enable appropriate access to therapy, strengthen clinic readiness, optimize buy-and-bill operations, and support a reliable patient and customer experience across the rare disease treatment journey.

**Responsibilities:**

**Account Strategy & Enterprise Value**

* Proactively assess the business environment across assigned accounts to identify access, operational, economic, and care-delivery barriers that affect appropriate rare disease therapy utilization, reducing time to diagnosis and time to treatment .
* Develop and execute account plans and identify Amgen portfolio objectives aligned to customer priorities, including addressing portfolio growth, patient access, site-of-care friction, and treatment continuity.
* Build stakeholder maps and engage clinical leaders, administrators, pharmacy, finance, revenue cycle, procurement, infusion operations, and care coordinators through proactive calls with key stakeholders
* Translate account data and insights into clear opportunity hypotheses, action plans, and performance reviews of sites.

**Clinic Contracting & Access**

* Serve as the commercial lead for assigned account contracting opportunities, coordinating internal approvals and supporting compliant negotiation and execution.
* Identify and address barriers related to contracting, customer membership, ordering, distribution channel, formulary or pathway decisions, and product availability.
* Partner with market access, pricing, trade, reimbursement, and legal/compliance colleagues to support durable access solutions.
* Support account business reviews that assess contract performance, patient access, operational readiness, and appropriate commercial opportunities.

**Buy-and-Bill Optimization & Site Enablement**

* Evaluate buy-and-bill workflows, including acquisition, inventory, benefit verification, prior authorization, coding, billing, payment, and financial risk points.
* Work with clinics and internal partners to identify practical improvements in reimbursement readiness, inventory practices, ordering processes, and patient financial navigation.
* Engage sites of care through education, workflow support, and coordinated resources that strengthen readiness to initiate and maintain therapy.
* Help customers diagnose and identify operational gaps that can delay treatment, including referral handoffs, scheduling, infusion capacity, care coordination, and post-initiation follow-up.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Insights**

* Coordinate field execution with sales, medical, patient services, market access, trade, analytics, and brand partners.
* Provide timely, actionable field insights into customer needs, competitive dynamics, reimbursement trends, and operational barriers with matrix colleagues.
* Monitor account performance and adapt priorities to deliver against agreed objectives in a compliant manner.
* Maintain accurate account plans, account affiliations, activity records, and opportunity documentation in required systems.
* Lead matrix planning and follow-through for priority account initiatives, clarifying partner roles, decision points, owners, and timelines.

**Win**

Associate’s degree and 10 years of sales experience and/or related account management experience

Flexcar gives people their own car with one monthly payment that includes insurance, maintenance, roadside, and registration, plus the freedom to swap, keep, or return it as life changes. It's more affordable, more flexible, and more enjoyable than buying or leasing. By combining operational expertise with technology, data, and AI, we're transforming every part of the customer journey. We're scaling fast, and we're building the next generation of leaders to scale with us.

**Job Summary**
===============

The Instructional Designer owns the training that turns new hires into confident, capable operators. This person is accountable for building the new-hire onboarding curriculum, e-learning modules, quizzes and knowledge checks, and hands-on exercises that teach every new employee how to do the job they were hired to do. Beyond onboarding, you will build and maintain ongoing and role-specific training, develop recurring certification and leadership development programs, deliver and support training in the field, partner with field leaders and subject-matter experts to keep content accurate as the operation evolves, and measure whether the training actually works, using completion, assessment, and on-the-job performance data to close the loop. Success in this role means new hires reach productivity faster, make fewer avoidable errors, and rate their onboarding as clear and useful.

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Curriculum & Program Design**
-------------------------------

* Design and build the end-to-end new-hire onboarding curriculum for field operations roles, sequenced from first day through full productivity
* Develop e-learning modules, quizzes and knowledge checks, and hands-on, job-realistic exercises that teach new hires the specific tasks of the role they were hired for
* Develop certification programs that keep field team members' skills current and verify ongoing proficiency
* Build leadership development programs that prepare high-performing operators for management roles

**Content Development & Delivery**
----------------------------------

* Produce engaging learning content in multiple formats - e-learning, video, job aids, facilitator guides, and instructor-led sessions (in person or virtual)
* Write clear, plain-language materials a new hire can follow without needing a manual or a shadow
* Build exercises and simulations that let new hires practice real tasks in a safe setting before doing them live
* Facilitate instructor-led sessions and train field leaders to deliver content consistently

**Subject-Matter Expert Partnership**
-------------------------------------

* Partner with leaders across the Operations org to capture how the job is really done and translate it into training
* Keep curriculum accurate and current as processes, tools, and vehicle-handling standards change
* Maintain a single source of truth for the standard operating procedures and job aids used in the field

**Assessment & Effectiveness**
------------------------------

* Design quizzes, skills assessments, and role certifications that verify a new hire can do the job, not just recall information
* Track completion, assessment scores, time-to-productivity, and early performance to measure whether training is working
* Use data and learner feedback to continuously improve the curriculum and close gaps

**What You Will Have**
======================

* A builder who can take a job that lives in people’s heads and turn it into clear, teachable training
* Strong instructional-design instincts - you start from what someone needs to be able to do and design backward from there
* Excellent writing and communication skills; you make complex procedures simple
* A confident facilitator, comfortable leading training in a classroom, on the floor, or virtually
* Comfortable getting out onto the floor - you learn the operation by watching it, not just reading about it
* Highly organized and self-directed, able to run multiple content projects at once and hit launch dates
* An analytical mindset - willing to measure whether training worked and change it when it didn’t
* Thrives in a fast-paced, multi-hub operation and stays close to the field

**Nice to Have**
================

* Experience designing onboarding or technical training, ideally for hourly, frontline, or field-based roles; familiarity with instructional-design methods and adult-learning principles
* Hands-on experience with building e-learning content and learning management systems (LMS)
* Experience building assessments, certifications, or competency models
* Background in operations, logistics, automotive, retail, or another hands-on field environment
* Bachelor’s degree in education, communications, or a related field - or equivalent hands-on experience

**What Tops The Tank**
======================

* Rest & Relaxation: Flexible PTO policy.
* Future Savings: Benefit from a 401(k) plan with company match from day one.
* Benefits: Day One - Excellent, low-cost healthcare coverage including medical, dental, vision.
* Drive a Flexcar! Discounted employee rate on Flexcar products and no annual membership fee.
* Weekly pay
* Other amazing perks

jobs.description:
**Description**

**Company Overview:**

When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end-to-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM

Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end-to-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud & Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.

**Position Overview:**

**Term: 6-month contract to hire**
  
**Location: Jersey City, NJ**
  
**Pay: $32.00**
  
**Hours: M – F 9 am – 6 pm**

As the Service Operations Specialist you will support both technical repair operations and global service logistics activities. This hybrid role combines hands-on hardware troubleshooting, repair, testing, and RMA processing with inventory management, field service logistics, parts reconciliation, and cross-functional coordination.

The ideal candidate will possess strong electronic repair skills, knowledge of server hardware, inventory and logistics experience, and the ability to work closely with internal teams, third-party logistics providers, field engineers, and customers. This position plays a critical role in ensuring product quality, inventory accuracy, service readiness, and customer satisfaction throughout the service lifecycle.

**What you will do as the Service Operations Specialist:**

*The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. This job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of the duties and responsibilities of the position, and the duties and responsibilities may change without notice.*

Repair & Technical Operations

* Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair Supermicro servers, storage, networking equipment, and RMA products to meet quality standards and customer requirements.
* Perform testing, calibration, and validation of repaired systems, components, and final assemblies.
* Conduct component-level troubleshooting, electronic circuit analysis, and hardware diagnostics.
* Perform component replacement and rework activities.
* Execute ECO upgrades and engineering changes as required.
* Follow technical procedures, drawings, specifications, and work instructions to complete repair assignments.
* Document repair findings and report defective components through RMA and service databases.
* Determine job status, material availability, and work order completion requirements.
* Provide onsite customer support and technical assistance when required.

Service Logistics & Inventory Management

* Manage inventory levels across field stocking locations (FSLs), depots, and service warehouses to ensure parts availability.
* Monitor inventory accuracy and reconcile inventory discrepancies across multiple systems and locations.
* Coordinate defective part returns and RMA processing to ensure assets are returned and tracked properly.
* Work with third-party logistics (3PL) providers to ensure timely parts dispatch and SLA compliance.
* Handle reverse logistics activities, including return tracking and disposition of service inventory.
* Perform physical inventory audits and onsite inventory reconciliations at service locations.
* Track and proactively follow up on outstanding and non-returned service parts.

Cross-Functional Coordination

* Collaborate with Accounting, Shipping, RMA, Operations, Product Management, and IT teams to maintain inventory accuracy.
* Support parts transfers, order entries, and inventory transactions within company systems.
* Assist with inventory reporting, data analysis, and reconciliation activities.
* Work with Product Managers to understand server and equipment configurations and identify configuration discrepancies.
* Escalate inventory shortages, service issues, and operational risks to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintain clear communication with internal teams, field engineers, and customers regarding service and logistics activities.

Documentation & Process Compliance

* Maintain accurate records of repairs, inventory transactions, RMAs, and service activities.
* Keep service inventory databases and tracking systems up to date.
* Support audit requirements through proper documentation and record retention.
* Identify opportunities to improve repair processes, inventory controls, and service operations.

**What you will bring to the team:**

Required Qualifications

* Technical school certificate, Associate degree, Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience in Electronics, Computer Technology, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in hardware repair, service operations, logistics, inventory management, or a related technical environment.
* Experience troubleshooting electronic systems and computer hardware.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel.
* Knowledge of inventory management, logistics operations, and RMA processes.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Detail-oriented with strong time management and prioritization capabil
