jobs.title: Lead Business Analyst, Capacity Planning - Supervision
jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------

Federal Reserve Bank of San FranciscoWe are the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco — public servants with a mission to advance the nation’s monetary, financial, and payment systems to build a stronger economy for all Americans. As part of the nation’s central bank, we are committed to understanding and serving the vibrant, expansive communities of the Twelfth District, which covers the nine western states of the U.S. That means we seek and appreciate new perspectives and build opportunities to learn and grow. At the SF Fed, we approach our work with integrity and a commitment to service.

The SF Fed’s Supervision Group is responsible for the supervision and regulation of state member banks, bank holding companies, savings and loan holding companies, financial holding companies, data service providers, trust companies, and foreign banking organizations that operate in the 12th District. Supervised institutions are in all states of our District, and range in size and complexity from small community organizations to some of the largest banking organizations in the country.

As Supervision evolves to meet increasingly complex regulatory and industry demands, we're looking for a **Lead Business Analyst** to help lead this transformation, shifting our approach to resource and skills planning from reactive to proactive and data driven. This is a high-visibility role, partnering closely with both the Resource Management Group (RMG) and Learning & Development (L&D) teams, where forecasting models, workforce analytics, and strategic insights will directly shape how Supervision builds a stronger, more agile examiner workforce. If you enjoy translating complex data into strategic action and want your work to have a meaningful, visible impact on how the SF Fed develops the people who supervise and safeguard the financial institutions of the 12th District—advancing our mission to build a stronger economy for all Americans—we invite you to apply.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain a capacity plan and forecasting model for Supervision resources, incorporating comprehensive demand forecasts and resource modeling inputs.
* Perform scenario-based planning and modeling to produce recommendations for future needs, assess impacts of strategic initiatives and change, and provide input to tactical scheduling and resourcing plans, including training plans, based on business data and knowledge of business processes/operations.
* Lead the collection, modeling, analysis, and interpretation of complex and/or broad data; identifies and interprets trends and patterns in datasets to support resourcing recommendations or insights and drive implementation of solutions.
* Analyze complex and/or broad data sets to support decisions on future skills needs, resource planning and allocation, strategic changes, and business issues that have a broad or highly significant impact.
* Conduct skills gap analysis across the examiner workforce to identify and prioritize training investments that build a stronger, more capable Supervision team.
* Thinks strategically and can look at business solutions from both top-down and bottoms-up approach and works to creatively solve problems.
* Leads cross-functional District and System-level projects and programs related to resource planning and learning initiatives; project manages ongoing efforts including stakeholder collaboration, meeting management, document organization, and follow-ups.
* Leads team projects/programs to address business issues; manages ongoing initiatives including stakeholder collaboration, meeting management, document organization, and follow ups.
* Produce reports and analyses to monitor resource availability and usage as well as the effectiveness of key learning and development programs.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in statistics, business, economics, finance, accounting, or a related field is preferred.
* Typically requires eight or more years of relevant experience in strategic planning, capacity planning, resource planning, or workforce management; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Proven analytical skills and problem-solving skills with experience in collecting, transforming, analyzing, and reporting complex data to drive significant business decisions.
* Experience in statistical analysis and modeling forecasts to support demand planning or capacity models within a business planning cycle with familiarity of key staffing metrics such as utilization, productivity, and attrition.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information clearly and concisely to all levels of leadership.
* Strong analytical/critical thinking skill and ability to apply sound judgment when making decisions of moderate to moderately high complexity with the ability to determine next steps in situations where information is unavailable or ambiguous.
* Prior experience leading cross-functional teams and programs across multiple stakeholder groups, with ability to drive District/System-wide initiatives from inception to execution.
* Proficient in the use of MS Office Suite (Excel), visualization software (Tableau), and programming languages such as SQL, R, Python, etc. to manipulate data and create reporting and visualizations from scratch.
* Willing and able to travel up to 10%.
This position requires access to confidential supervisory information, which is limited to “Protected Individuals.” Protected Individuals include, but are not limited to, U.S. citizens and U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents who are not yet eligible to apply for naturalization, and U.S. permanent residents who have applied for naturalization within six months of being eligible to do so or who will sign a declaration of intent to apply for naturalization before they begin employment.

jobs.description:
*Empowering Wellness, Transforming Lives*

Optima Medical Management Group is dedicated to enhancing the quality of life by promoting wellness. At Optima MMG and all of its divisions: Serene Health, Community Support, and American TrueCare, our mission is to provide comprehensive support and care that not only addresses immediate concerns but also fosters long-term well-being.

As pioneers in the field, we aspire to lead in member care outcomes and set new standards for excellence and innovation. We are committed to empowering our members to achieve self-sufficiency in health, creating a ripple effect that strengthens families and communities.

Our work culture at Optima MMG is built on pride, passion, and a collective commitment to making a positive difference in people's lives. Our team members are dedicated problem-solvers who bring their unique skills and perspectives to the table. We believe that by fostering a collaborative and supportive environment, we can unlock the full potential of our team and, in turn, provide the best possible care to our members.

A career at Optima MMG is an opportunity to be part of a dynamic and forward-thinking organization. We encourage continuous learning and professional growth, providing our employees with access to industry experts, cutting-edge technologies, and a supportive community that values each individual's contributions. Join us on this journey to not only advance your career but to be a driving force in transforming lives and communities through passionate and fulfilling work!

**Job Summary:**

The Community Health Worker (CHW) serves as a trusted liaison between community members, healthcare providers, and social service organizations. Working as an integral, mostly remote member of the pod's interdisciplinary Care Team, alongside Lead Care Managers, MAs, and RNs, the CHW is responsible for conducting outreach, providing health education, addressing social determinants of health, and connecting members to medical, behavioral health, and community-based resources. Under the general supervision of Enhanced Care Management Leadership, the CHW works closely with members, families, care teams, and community partners to improve health outcomes, promote self-sufficiency, and reduce barriers to care; working mainly remotely alongside the Lead Care Managers for direct member engagement. This position requires strong communication skills, cultural sensitivity, and a passion for serving diverse populations.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary team member to conduct in-person visits to community members and provide education on health-related topics.

* Assist individuals in accessing healthcare services, social services, and community resources.

* Assess social determinants of health and identify barriers impacting member well-being and healthcare access.

* Support care coordination activities and collaborate with healthcare providers, care managers, social workers, and community agencies.

* Function as an integral, mostly remote member of the pod Care Team, partnering closely with Lead Care Managers, MAs, and RNs who conduct direct member engagement.

* Accompany members to appointments when appropriate and assist with healthcare system, insurance program, and benefit enrollment navigation.

* Maintain ongoing contact with members through phone calls, home visits, community outreach, and telehealth platforms.

* Document member interactions, assessments, and referrals accurately and timely in designated systems.

* Advocate for members and assist with resolving barriers that interfere with access to care and services.

* Participate in community outreach events, health fairs, educational workshops, and engagement activities.

* Maintain member confidentiality and comply with all organizational and regulatory requirements.

* Participate in regularly scheduled member huddles for updates and feedback.

* Reporting in-person to the office as needed for meetings.

* Perform additional duties as assigned.

  

**Populations of Focus:**

* **Individuals experiencing homelessness:** Lacking a fixed, regular, and adequate nighttime residence.

* **Individuals at risk for avoidable hospital or emergency department utilization:** Five or more emergency room visits in a six-month period that could have been avoided with appropriate outpatient care or improved treatment adherence.

* **Individuals with Serious Mental Health and/ or substance use disorder needs:** Adults who meet the eligibility criteria for participation in, or obtaining services through Specialist mental health services or the Drug Medi-Cal organized delivery system or Drug Medi-Cal program.

* **Individuals transitioning from incarceration/Justice Involved:** Adults transitioning from a correctional setting or transitioned from a correction setting within the past 12 months, or children and youth who are transitioning from a youth correctional facility or transitioned from being in a youth correctional facility within the past 12 months.

* **Adults living in the community and at risk for long-term care institutionalization:** Adults who are living in the community who meet the SNF Level of Care criteria; or who require lower-acuity skilled nursing or equipment for prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of acute illness or injury.

* **Adult nursing facility residents transitioning to the community:** Adult nursing residents who are interested in moving out of the institution, and are likely candidates to do so successfully, and are able to reside continuously in the community.

* **Children and youth enrolled in California Children's Services (CCS) or CCS Whole Child Model (WCM) with Additional Needs Beyond the CCS condition:** Children and youth enrolled in CCS or CCS WCM and are experiencing at least one complex social factor influencing their health.

* **Children and Youth Involved in Child Welfare**

* **Individuals with Intellectual/ Developmental Disabilities:** Adu

jobs.description:
Lycia Therapeutics (Nasdaq: LYCA) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company using its proprietary lysosomal targeting chimera (LYTAC) platform to discover and develop therapeutics that degrade extracellular and membrane-bound proteins. These proteins drive a wide range of difficult-to-treat diseases, including autoimmune, inflammatory, and allergic conditions. Lycia was established in 2019 in collaboration with academic founder and Nobel Laureate Carolyn Bertozzi, Ph.D., professor of chemistry and HHMI investigator at Stanford University. In October 2026, Lycia completed an initial public offering, and its common stock now trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol “LYCA.” Lycia is headquartered in South San Francisco.

Visit https://lyciatx.com/ for more information.

**The Role:**

The Executive Assistant/Office Manager provides direct administrative support to Lycia’s Chief Business Officer, Chief Scientific Officer, and Chief Medical Officer, coordinates interviews for our hiring teams, and keeps our South San Francisco office running smoothly day to day. Working alongside Lycia’s other Executive Assistant, this role also serves on the company’s safety committee and leads the planning of our social and culture events. The ideal candidate is detail oriented, resourceful, and proactive, exercises sound judgment with confidential information, and is energized by a mix of executive support, recruiting coordination, and hands-on office work. This is an on-site position based in our South San Francisco office, with occasional travel to support advisory board meetings.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Office Management:**

* Keep Lycia’s office space organized, presentable, and functional.
* Serve as a liaison with building management and office vendors on office-related requests.
* Maintain a well-stocked kitchen, track supply inventory, and order general office supplies; manage purchasing and vendor relationships for the office within budget.
* Set up conference rooms and audiovisual and IT equipment for meetings
* Manage incoming and outgoing mail and shipments.

**Executive Support:**

* Manage complex calendars for the Chief Business Officer, Chief Scientific Officer, and Chief Medical Officer, proactively resolving conflicts and protecting time for top priorities.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including itineraries, bookings, and last-minute changes.
* Coordinate logistics for internal and external meetings, including scheduling, venues, catering, materials, and meeting setup, and travel to support these meetings on-site as needed.
* Handle confidential information with discretion, in accordance with Lycia’s confidentiality and insider trading policies.

**People & Culture:**

* Schedule and coordinate interviews across the R&D organization, including multi-interviewer and on-site interview days.
* Support onboarding of new hires, partnering with hiring managers and HR on workspace, equipment, and company swag.
* Serve as a member of Lycia’s safety committee, and coordinate and schedule safety trainings for employees.
* Coordinate team events, such as offsites, happy hours, and company celebrations, that strengthen Lycia’s culture and sense of community.

### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience as an executive assistant and/or office manager, including direct support of C-level executives.
* Experience coordinating advisory board or scientific meetings and interview scheduling preferred.
* Biotech or life sciences company experience preferred.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing demands across multiple executives.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* A high level of discretion and professionalism in handling confidential information.
* Ability to multitask and to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* A track record of anticipating needs, solving problems, and following through.
* Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities.
* Ability to work on-site in South San Francisco and to travel occasionally to support external meetings.
* Ability to lift and carry office supplies and packages of up to 25 pounds.

The expected base salary range for this role is $120,000-143,000. We encourage candidates of all levels to apply as there is often flexibility on job title and responsibilities. Compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Lycia offers a competitive employment package that includes an annual bonus, equity, and a generous benefits package.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Join CBX Solutions, the nation’s leading provider of architectural doors, frames, hardware, specialty products, and complete security integration services.
  
At CBX Solutions, trust and communication are the foundation of how we work. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture where your voice is heard, your ideas matter, and your career has room to grow. Whether you're a problem-solver, innovator, or passionate about service, you’ll thrive here. Be part of a team that invests in your future, celebrates your success, and values your contribution.

* Career Growth: You’ll benefit from continuous learning, mentorship, and leadership training including access to CBX University, our in-house development program.

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Empowering Businesses. Enabling Success.**

At Visual Edge IT, we help organizations nationwide harness the power of technology to work smarter, stay secure, and grow stronger. From managed IT services and cybersecurity to print solutions and document workflow, we deliver innovative, customized strategies that give our clients the edge in an ever-changing business landscape. Our nationwide network combines the personalized service of local teams with the strength and resources of a national leader—ensuring that every client gets both technology that works and people who care.

With more than two decades of experience and a team of over 1,000 technology professionals, we pride ourselves on building partnerships that go beyond service contracts. When you join Visual Edge IT, you become part of a collaborative, solutions-driven culture where your expertise helps shape the future for businesses across the country. Together, we don’t just solve technology challenges—we create opportunities for success.

***Job Summary:***

Visual Edge IT is seeking a relationship-driven **Territory Account Manager** to grow and expand an established portfolio of existing customers. This role is focused on deepening client partnerships, increasing wallet share, and delivering an exceptional customer experience through proactive engagement and strategic account management.

As a trusted advisor, you will work closely with customers to understand their business goals, conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and identify opportunities across our full portfolio—including Managed Services, Cloud, Security, Print & Workflow, and Professional Services. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on retention, expansion, and long-term value creation.

***Primary Responsibilities***

* Manage and grow a defined territory of existing customer accounts, consistently meeting or exceeding quarterly and annual revenue goals.
* Drive account expansion by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities across managed IT, cloud, cybersecurity, print/workflow, and professional services.
* Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to evaluate performance, uncover business needs, and align technology solutions to customer objectives.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans that support customer retention, expansion, and long-term partnership growth.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, building trusted relationships through proactive communication and follow-through.
* Monitor account health, identify risks early, and partner with internal teams to resolve issues before they impact satisfaction or revenue.
* Collaborate with solution architects, technical specialists, and service delivery teams to design and position solutions that solve customer challenges.
* Maintain a strong, accurate sales pipeline and provide reliable forecasting through CRM discipline.
* Partner cross-functionally with service delivery, support, and leadership to ensure seamless onboarding, service quality, and customer experience.
* Participate in internal sales meetings, training sessions, and cross-functional initiatives that support territory and organizational growth

***Knowledge, Skills, and Qualifications***

* 3+ years of account management or sales experience within technology, managed services, or a related B2B environment.
* Demonstrated success growing existing accounts and achieving revenue targets through relationship-based selling
* Strong understanding of technology solutions such as managed IT services, cloud, cybersecurity, print/workflow, and professional services.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at multiple levels.

jobs.title: Patient Enrollment Specialist
jobs.description:
DayaMed is seeking a motivated, personable, and results-oriented Patient Enrollment Specialist to join our growing team!

In this role, you will connect with patients referred by our partner healthcare practices, educate them about Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Chronic Care Management (CCM) programs, and guide interested individuals through the enrollment process.

* Participate in ongoing training, coaching, and performance improvement initiatives.

* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and working toward measurable performance goals.
* Ability to accurately document information while navigating multiple computer applications.

* Willingness to receive feedback, participate in coaching, and contribute to team objectives.
* Commitment to protecting patient information and maintaining confidentiality.

* Previous experience with Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), or other healthcare enrollment programs.

* Familiarity with electronic health records (EHR), patient management systems, or CRM platforms.

Run the agency so the founder can build it.

We're a seven-figure ecommerce marketing agency on our way to $2–3M, and we need the person who makes that growth feel calm instead of chaotic. You'll get the keys to how the agency runs: people, process, capacity and the money side of ops. You'll also get a founder who actually wants to let go of them.

One 10 Media isn't just another eCommerce growth agency. We run Meta and Google Ads and Klaviyo email and SMS retention for DTC brands. We're a top Klaviyo partner. **The Role**

**Pay & Perks**

Apply with your resume and a short answer to the questions.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager will take primary responsibility within the project team for planning, coordinating, and delivering project activities through the entire project life cycle, from pre-development through construction and handoff to the client, on major, complex, and business-critical projects. Under the general direction of the Project Director, the SPM delivers CMD’s Owner’s Advisor Services as an extension of the client’s team, independently leading day-to-day execution to meet schedule, budget, quality, and client objectives, in conformance with CMD’s project management methodologies and standards.

The SPM brings CMD’s core values to every relationship (internally and externally) and engagement. Stewardship: take ownership of what is ours, following through on our commitments, and caring for the people, resources and responsibilities entrusted to us. Collaboration: building an aligned and effective team through working together with openness, trust, and shared purpose, valuing the perspectives and contributions of everyone involved. Professionalism: holding ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do, bringing expertise, integrity, and dedication to every engagement from start to finish. The SPM will lead multidisciplinary international project teams, independently direct day-to-day planning, design management, and construction activities, and be instrumental to the successful development, implementation, and delivery of a highly complex, ground-up ultra-luxury resort and branded residential development on a remote island in the Caribbean.

#### **DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

Project Leadership and Client Relations

* Assume primary responsibility for independently directing daytoday project execution, establishing projectspecific objectives, priorities, policies, and procedures, and ensuring accountability across all project disciplines.
* Serve as a senior representative of the client in coordinating with ownership, internationally recognized architects and designers, engineering consultants, contractors, operators, and regulatory agencies. Lead highlevel project meetings, drive critical decisions, and provide executivelevel briefings on project milestones, financial performance, risks, and strategic recommendations.
* Exercise independent judgment in anticipating and resolving complex project challenges, proactively identifying risks, evaluating technical and commercial implications, and implementing effective solutions while escalating major strategic matters to the Project Director.
* Provide leadership and direction to multidisciplinary project teams, holding consultants and contractors accountable for performance, deliverables, and project objectives. Mentor junior project staff in technical coordination, design management, and project management methodologies and standards.

#### **Pre-Development**

* Lead early planning efforts, including site analysis, feasibility studies, land planning, area programming, master planning, infrastructure assessments, and conceptual design, ensuring alignment with the client’s development objectives and ultraluxury hospitality expectations.
* Direct technical due diligence of site conditions, infrastructure, environmental constraints, and development risks to inform project decisions.
* Lead preliminary budgets, cost estimates, financial models, and master schedules; assess design feasibility and construction approaches.
* Recommend project delivery, contracting, procurement, phasing, and bid packaging strategies suited to remote island logistics and available resources.
* Coordinate entitlements, permitting, and regulatory approvals, identifying potential obstacles early.

Gridworks seeks a Senior Project Manager to oversee assigned high voltage substation projects from planning and estimating through design, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, energization, turnover, and warranty. The position owns project execution, financial performance, client relationships, and coordination with utilities and field leadership.

**About the Company**
=====================

Established in 2014, Gridworks is a leading EPC contractor for utility-scale solar and battery storage projects. Primarily operating across the southwest, we are expanding into other regions. With 2 GW of solar and battery energy storage projects we are well positioned for continued success in the rapidly growing clean energy sector.

**About Us**:

CALSTART is now Catalyst Mobility. We are a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.

For over 30 years, it’s been Catalyst Mobility’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. Catalyst Mobility works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. Catalyst Mobility provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

**About The Role**:

As Lead Project Manager, Equitable Electric Mobility, you will help Catalyst Mobility drive equitable zero-emission transportation policies and programs across our priority states. This role will live within Catalyst's Innovative Mobility team, and your primary focus for the upcoming year will be managing operational and program activities within the Towards Equitable Electric Mobility (TEEM) Community of Practice, a collaborative initiative between Catalyst Mobility and The Greenlining Institute.

In this role, you will work with TEEM partners on setting strategic direction in alignment with Catalyst Mobility's broader organizational goals. You will work in close partnership with The Greenlining Institute to deliver hands-on coordination, capacity building, and peer-learning opportunities for a cohort of state-based environmental and equity organizations. You will help execute multi-state project goals, track deliverables, administer program budgets, handle reporting, and oversee efforts to attract additional funding for this work. jobs.title: Program Manager, Escalation Management
jobs.description:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

### **Overview**

We are seeking a Program Manager to orchestrate how Instacart responds to its most critical escalations, including executive-raised issues and issues from our most strategic retail partners. When something is urgent, ambiguous, and spans multiple teams, you bring clarity, drive resolution, and make sure it doesn’t happen again. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Customer Experience.

You’ll be responsible for moving our model from reactive to proactive. That means defining the risk signals that trigger early intervention, building recovery paths for known risk vectors, and turning recurring issues into data-backed product change requests. This is a strategic and analytical role for a resourceful professional with strong judgment under pressure. It is critical for building a scalable escalation process that earns the trust of internal stakeholders and key retail partners.

The Customer Experience team ensures that critical issues affecting our retailers, customers, and shoppers are resolved quickly and permanently. The team operates globally across a network of BPO partners and works closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Business Development to provide immediate resolution and address systemic root cause issues.

### **About the Job**

**Program Operations & SLA Governance:**

* Run the escalation operating rhythm end to end: daily case review, weekly escalation review, monthly business review, and quarterly calibration of severity criteria.
* Keep meeting hygiene tight: agendas, decisions logged, and action items assigned with named owners and due dates.
* Manage a central tracker that captures every escalation signal and root-cause action and routes each to a named owner.
* Publish and drive SLAs, and report adherence, escalation cycle time, and signal-to-action lag to leadership weekly. [Targets to be set]

**Proactive Service Recovery:**

* Define and maintain risk-detection signals that support early intervention.
* Design recovery paths for known risk vectors, so issues are resolved before users have to escalate.

**Root-Cause & Program Delivery:**

* Identify and size the frequency and impact of patterns across escalations, and turn them into effective solutions that reduce repeat issues.
* Drive cross-functional execution with Product, Engineering, Operations, and the rest of Customer Experience so every signal has a destination, every action has an owner, and every outcome is measured.

**Data, Analytics & Reporting:**

* Write SQL queries to investigate spikes, isolate root causes, and answer ad-hoc questions from CX, Product, and Operations leaders.
* Build and maintain dashboards and automated reporting tracking escalation volume, time to resolution, recurring themes, SLA adherence, and partner impact.
* Prepare leaders for key partner meetings, business reviews, and incident readouts with clear, quantified impact.

**Process & Playbook:**

* Define and improve escalation intake, severity criteria, SLAs, and communication standards.
* Build repeatable processes that scale beyond the team.

jobs.description:
**About This Opportunity**
--------------------------

At JDA TSG, we continuously partner with leading enterprise SaaS and technology brands to build and scale high-performing Customer Success organizations. Because our client partnerships and program scopes expand frequently, we proactively maintain an active candidate pipeline for Customer Success Manager roles across multiple account tiers. **This is an evergreen posting designed to connect with top-tier talent for upcoming and immediate openings.** By applying, you allow our talent team to evaluate your profile now so we can move quickly with pre-aligned candidates as new client roles launch.

### **Role Summary**

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), you will serve as the dedicated advisor and post-sales owner for a portfolio of business accounts across varied industries. We believe long-term client retention isn't achieved through quick support tickets; it relies on proactive relationship building, root-cause problem solving, and driving ongoing platform utilization. By understanding client business goals, guiding onboarding, and coordinating internal teams to remove adoption barriers, your work protects account health, drives product utilization, and maximizes customer lifetime value.

* **Portfolio Management & Value Realization:** You will manage a designated book of client accounts, conducting regular business reviews and connecting platform features directly to the client’s core business outcomes. Success is measured by gross revenue retention, portfolio health score movement, and client satisfaction (CSAT) ratings.
* **Proactive Risk Mitigation & Adoption Tracking:** You will monitor customer usage trends, identify early churn or health decay signals, and execute intervention plans before account health deteriorates. Success is measured by churn reduction, rapid resolution of adoption stalls, and account health stability.
* **Expansion Advocacy & Cross-Functional Leadership:** You will identify organic growth opportunities during routine customer touchpoints and collaborate with internal product, support, and sales teams to resolve complex client challenges. Success is measured by qualified lead generation for expansion, account renewals, and seamless cross-functional resolution.

  

* At least 2 to 5 years of experience in a customer-facing Customer Success, Account Management, or consultative client engagement role within B2B environments.
* Demonstrated experience managing a client portfolio, with a clear understanding of retention metrics, engagement cadences, and priority management.
* Consultative discovery skills to diagnose root causes of operational friction rather than defaulting to quick ticket resolution.
* Proven track record of influencing customer behavior, removing software adoption barriers, and tying ongoing product usage directly to client ROI.
* Ability to recognize early churn or health decay signals from usage data and execute a proactive retention plan.
* Clear, concise, and credible communication skills to simplify complex technical steps and manage sensitive retention conversations.
* Skill in leveraging customer usage data, account value metrics, and health scores to prioritize daily workflow across a varied account base.
* Commercial judgment to spot organic expansion and feature-attach opportunities during routine customer interactions without taking a high-pressure sales stance.

new_jobs.title: Automation Program Manager, Legal and Compliance Operations
new_jobs.description:
Legal and Compliance Operations is seeking an Automation Program Manager to help us automate high-volume review at scale across Legal and Compliance workflows. Our workflows run on a composite of LLM-based decisioning, rules-based logic that encodes policy directly, and signals drawn from reporter history, content matching and behavioral patterns. Automation now carries a substantial share of enforcement volume, which means its quality determines both the legal risk we mitigate and the experience of the rights holders, regulators and people who depend on these decisions.As an Automation Program Manager, you will own the measured quality of assigned automations. Half of the role is forward motion: taking an automation from where it performs today to where the operational plan requires, through iteration on prompts, rules and signal thresholds. The other half is regression response: when reliability, correctness, precision or recall degrades, you find out why and drive it back. An effective candidate in this role is rigorous about measurement, comfortable working across all three automation types, and able to tell a genuine regression apart from a shift in what is arriving.  
  
  

### **Automation Program Manager, Legal and Compliance Operations Responsibilities:**

* Hill-climb reliability (prompt, iterate and improve), correctness, precision and recall on assigned automations across Legal and Compliance Workflows
* Iterate on LLM components, including prompts, task decomposition, routing, and abstention and fallback behavior
* Diagnose and improve rules-based components, including coverage, ordering and precedence, conflicts between rules, rules firing on the wrong population, and rules that stop matching after a policy or schema change
* Tune signal-based components, including thresholds, signal freshness and availability, and the precision cost of upstream signal drift
* Investigate regressions to isolate whether the cause is model, rule, signal, upstream data, policy change, or a shift in the incoming population, and distinguish real degradation from volume mix shift
* Drive regressions to a measured recovery that holds across a following measurement period, and document what degraded, why it was not caught earlier, and what detection would have caught it
* Build and maintain offline eval and gold standard data sets, coordinating expert-review sampling with the reviewers who hold the ground truth
* Build regression detection that surfaces degradation before the next reporting cycle, and close measurement coverage gaps so automations that are live are also measured
* Build scripts, notebooks and internal tooling so program managers and operations leads can run measurement independently
* Document what was tried, what moved the metric, and what did not, so subsequent workflows start further along

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of relevant experience in data annotation, labeling, quality assurance, or content review operations, including time spent close to automated decision output
* Experience with guideline accuracy and inter-rater agreement, including diagnosing why qualified reviewers disagree
* Working knowledge of Python and SQL, with experience pulling a dataset, computing precision and recall, and segmenting results to locate where loss is concentrated
* Experience reading and reasoning about conditional logic to trace how a decision was reached
* Experience working with large operational datasets in a notebook environment
* Investigative approach to metric movement, identifying cause rather than the explanation that fits
* Experience communicating results clearly, including reporting a metric that has not moved or a regression that is not yet explained

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in adversarial or fraud-adjacent domains where the reviewed population actively shifts
* Experience with rules engines, decision tables, routing logic or classifier thresholds
* Experience coordinating with vendor or cross-functional reviewer pools
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience or expertise in legal and compliance operations, or trust and safety
* Experience iterating on prompts with measured before-and-after results
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

new_jobs.description:
Under the general direction of the Director, Health Major Capital, the Senior Project Manager (Sr. PM) manages multiple capital projects ranging from $50,000 to $500 million, ensuring delivery on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with quality, operational, and program requirements. The Sr. PM provides project management services throughout the project lifecycle, with primary responsibility for equipment planning, furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E), procurement, operational readiness, activation, occupancy, and closeout.

The Sr. PM leads and coordinates multidisciplinary teams including architects, engineers, contractors, equipment vendors, furniture suppliers, Information Technology, Supply Chain, Facilities Management, clinical users, regulatory agencies, and other UCSF stakeholders. Responsibilities include developing and managing equipment budgets, procurement and activation plans, project schedules, vendor and consultant agreements, relocations, and occupancy readiness.

Representing UCSF Health as an owner's representative, the Sr. PM supports new construction, expansions, renovations, and retrofit projects. The Sr. PM reviews design documents for equipment infrastructure, utilities, operational functionality, infection prevention, phasing, and fire/life safety requirements and coordinates equipment installation and activation to minimize project risk and ensure operational readiness.

The Sr. PM maintains accurate project schedules, budgets, forecasts, procurement records, activation milestones, and reporting using internal project management systems. The role supports Capital Budget development and ensures documentation is complete for occupancy, activation, project closeout, audit readiness, and informed decision-making.

Working with a high degree of autonomy, the Sr. PM exercises independent judgment in managing medium- to large-scale projects of moderate to difficult complexity and may coordinate the work of other Project Managers and Assistant Project Managers.

* Develop and manage project, procurement, activation, occupancy, and close out schedules and budgets.

* Lead FF&E, medical equipment, IT, signage, relocation, move management, activation, and operational transition activities.
* Coordinate vendors, contractors, clinical departments, regulatory agencies, and UCSF support teams.
* Ensure required documentation and readiness activities are completed before occupancy and activation.
* Apply LEAN practices and identify opportunities to improve project delivery.
* Build strong relationships across UCSF and foster a collaborative culture of accountability, trust, and integrity.

Position will work at all UCSF Health locations throughout the San Francisco Bay Area, including new off-campus lease sites. All Real Estate staff are required to be on-site, in-person, no less than four full days per week, although project activities may require additional on-site presence. The PM is required to be responsive to project needs and demands throughout planning, procurement, activation, occupancy, and project closeout.

Typical project budgets are hundreds of millions of dollars. Our goals are delivered through Integrated Project Delivery (IPD) methodologies. Our vision is to be recognized as an innovative and collaborative owner through new processes, innovation of new delivery models, contracts, and commercial terms that will attract the most qualified teams. Our projects are managed in the Integrated Center for Design and Construction (Big Room). Our work emphasizes the development of highly integrated and collaborative teamwork. We fully support and integrate Lean tools in our project work.

The combined UCSF Campus and Health organizations include approximately 198 UCSF and 38 contract personnel; operating/recharge budgets of more than $52.2M per year; current year capital project expenditures of $900 million; and oversight and responsibility for > $13.3 billion long-range capital development.

new_jobs.title: Operations Manager, Marketing Agency
new_jobs.description:
Operations Manager, Ecommerce Marketing Agency (Remote)

Run the agency so the founder can build it.

We're a seven-figure ecommerce marketing agency on our way to $2–3M, and we need the person who makes that growth feel calm instead of chaotic. You'll get the keys to how the agency runs: people, process, capacity and the money side of ops. You'll also get a founder who actually wants to let go of them.

**About Us**

One 10 Media isn't just another eCommerce growth agency. We run Meta and Google Ads and Klaviyo email and SMS retention for DTC brands. We're a top Klaviyo partner. We're a fully remote team of 10+ who have been working together for several years. We genuinely care about the work, the results, and each other. We're proactive, we say the thing even when it's uncomfortable, and we work with no egos and no silos.

**The Role**

You'll run day-to-day operations and report directly to our Founder & CEO, which frees him to focus on growth. This is a real ownership seat, not an assistant role. You set the rhythm, make the calls, and build the systems that let a small agency scale without breaking. The seat can grow into Director of Operations as we grow.

Full-time, remote (US) on Eastern business hours.

**What You'll Own**

* People and policies: team policies, PTO and time off approvals and coverage, and the team policy book.

* Capacity and resourcing: who's working on what, workload across client pods, and when we need to hire.

* Time and utilization: Harvest time tracking, weekly reviews and reporting that tells us where the hours (and margins) go.

* Team rhythm: team meetings, the operating cadence and following action items through to done.

* Hiring and onboarding: finding, trialing, onboarding and offboarding employees and contractors, including access, paperwork and first-30-day plans.

* Process: our SOPs and Asana setup, working with our SOP/QA coordinator so everything has an owner and a due date.

* Billing ops: invoicing follow-up, collections and contractor and creator payments (W-9s, fee tracking), working with our outside bookkeeper.

* Admin: contracts, renewals, tools and subscriptions, and the small asks that keep everything moving.

* Client experience: keep operations running smoothly all year so clients stay happy.

* Automation and AI: simple automations and AI workflows (Zapier, Claude, ChatGPT and similar) that keep admin light.

**You Might Be a Fit If**

* You've helped a small agency (ideally ecommerce, performance or email marketing) grow through the ~$1M to $3M stage, and you know what breaks along the way.

* You'd rather build a checklist than send the same reminder twice, and you hold people to it kindly and consistently.

* You're comfortable with the money side (invoices, collections, contractor pay) and with spreadsheets.

* You know Asana, Harvest (or Toggl/Clockify), Slack and Google Workspace, and you reach for AI to get things done faster.

* You write clearly, follow up in writing and don't wait for problems to escalate.

* You like autonomy and want a founder who hands you real decisions, not busywork.

* Bonus: you've worked a BFCM season, or you know Klaviyo, Meta Ads Manager, Shopify or QuickBooks.

**Pay & Perks**

* $85K–$115K base, depending on experience

* Performance-based incentives

* Fully remote, with a "work from anywhere" culture that takes work/life balance seriously

* Training and an education budget for your professional and personal growth

* Real autonomy to shape the role, with a path to Director of Operations

* Annual company events and team retreats

**How to Apply**

Apply with your resume and a short answer to the questions.

We read every answer. If this sounds like your kind of job, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan

Application Question(s):

* Tell us about an agency that you scaled. What was your role and contribution?

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Project Manager – RFP & Implementation Readiness
new_jobs.description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

  

The **Project Manager – RFP & Implementation Readiness** connects Proposal Management, Business Development, and PMO leadership throughout the RFP process. This role ensures implementation plans, timelines, staffing, and commitments made during proposals are realistic and can be successfully delivered after contract award.

The role supports proposal development by collaborating in the creation and validation of project plans, identifying risks and dependencies, and coordinating with PMO and delivery leaders to ensure teams are prepared for potential new work.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary PMO point of contact for implementation-related RFP and proposal activities.
* Partner with Proposal Management, Business Development, Solution Architects, and delivery leaders to develop realistic implementation approaches.
* Develop and validate project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, staffing needs, and implementation timelines using delivery experience and historical project data to ensure proposed commitments are achievable.
* Identify and address risks, assumptions, resource constraints, and unrealistic delivery commitments before proposals are submitted.
* Provide PMO leadership with visibility into upcoming opportunities, staffing needs, and implementation readiness.
* Ensure appropriate project leadership and resources are identified for anticipated contract awards.
* Coordinate the transition from proposal to implementation, ensuring project teams understand key commitments, risks, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Develop and improve implementation planning standards, templates, and processes using lessons learned and actual project performance to improve future estimates and delivery commitments.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of project management, program management, PMO, or implementation leadership experience.
* Experience developing and managing complex project plans for large-scale government implementations.
* Strong knowledge of project scheduling, resource planning, dependencies, critical path analysis, and project lifecycle management.
* Experience supporting RFP, proposal, bid, or pre-sales activities.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to challenge assumptions and influence decisions across teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP or similar project management certification.
* Experience with government, public sector, or large-scale technology implementations.
* Experience with portfolio, capacity, and resource planning.
* Experience working across proposal, sales, solution engineering, and delivery teams.

**Flexible Working**

At Conduent, we want you to be yourself. We recognize that everyone is different and that how people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.

In this role, you can expect the following working conditions:

**Working For You**

Perks and rewards designed for you:

**Retirement Savings:** We will support you as you save for your future.

**Employee Discounts:** We offer you access to a vast selection of global, national, and local discounts on merchandise, services, travel, and more

**Career Growth Opportunities:** We help you thrive, so together, we can grow. We provide opportunities to advance your career with a vast portfolio of businesses and a global footprint.

**Paid Training:** Earn while you learn and continue to grow with access to award-winning learning platforms throughout your Conduent career.

**Paid time off:** We provide attractive paid time off packages designed for you to enjoy your life away from work.

**Great Work Environment:** We are proud of our award-winning culture and the recognition we’ve received for our diversity efforts.

**Join Us**

At Conduent, we are one team, one mission. We understand that our success is directly related to the success of our associates.

We strive to create a culture where you can:

* Bring your authentic self to work.
* Grow and thrive, both personally and professionally.
* Make a difference with our clients, in our communities, and with the millions of people we support.

When you join Conduent, you are engaged in creating the future - both our company’s and your own. With more than 60,000 associates across 24 countries, we will provide you the opportunity to grow with a team of people who will challenge and inspire you to be the best!

new_jobs.title: 2UniFi-Enterprise Technology - Digital Business Analyst II
new_jobs.description:
It starts with our culture ...
  
Common sense has never been common.
  
If it were, the world would be a different place. Things would run smoothly and on time. People would do what they say and say what they do. Everything would be fair, without all the small talk. And banks would only sell you what you need. When a banker looked at a client, they wouldn’t just see a number, they’d see a dad or a mom or a graduate or a business owner. Our Bankers understand the complexities of people’s lives and offer simple solutions.
  
That's the basics of Relationships. Fairness. Simplicity®. When you choose our Company, you have an opportunity to make an impact beyond the walls of our buildings.
  
We have a long-standing commitment to Equity, Diversity and Inclusion. Through our banking relationships, investing, grants, and volunteerism, NBH Bank promotes the growth, revitalization and sustainability of the communities we serve. We believe that these are important elements in building and sustaining a successful organization and a positive, results-driven culture. We strive for all of our associates to feel welcome and empowered at work.
  
As a Digital Business Analyst II, you will be responsible for supporting the bank’s Finxact core (Fiserv’s cloud-native, API-first, real-time platform) and Savana, a digital banking platform that connects to the core to deliver user-friendly operational support for back-office teams. The role also supports the money movement services that connect to the core, including ACH, wires, billpay, debit cards, and mobile deposit. You will translate business needs into product configurations, API integrations, and process changes across deposits, lending, money movement, and the ledger. You’ll work independently on moderately complex initiatives and partner with an application architect on core configuration needs.
  
As a Digital Business Analyst II, you will have an opportunity to elicit and document business and functional requirements, including BRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, for Finxact and Savana setup, enhancements and integrations. You will define and validate configuration for deposit and loan products, such as rates, fees, interest accrual, transaction codes and GL mapping. You will also partner with Product to shape the roadmap for new Finxact and Savana features, assessing feasibility and sizing the impact on core configuration, APIs and downstream systems. You will write test scenarios, run end-to-end testing across channels and manage defects to closure. Along the way, you will work with Fiserv/Finxact teams, internal developers and integration vendors on change requests, test environment management and release cycles. When production issues arise, you will troubleshoot, perform root-cause analysis and recommend permanent fixes. You will produce operational reporting on deposit, lending and money movement activity to support decision-making and identify process improvements. You will maintain requirements, configuration and procedure documentation and support associate training, and you will communicate status, risks and dependencies to project managers and stakeholders. You will also perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements:** This position requires the following educational and/or job experience:
  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 3–5 years of business analysis experience, including 2+ years in banking
* Hands-on experience with Finxact, or another modern core (Mambu, Thought Machine Vault, Fiserv DNA, Jack Henry) with a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on API-driven platforms
* Experience with Savana, or a comparable digital banking or process orchestration platform (nCino, Pega, Alkami, Backbase, Apiture) that connects to a core, with the ability to learn quickly
* Understanding of bank operations (account servicing, exceptions, reconciliations, disputes, month-end closing) gained in an operations, branch, or back-office setting
* Working knowledge of APIs, including reading OpenAPI/Swagger specs, interpreting JSON payloads, and testing with Postman or similar tools
* Familiarity with event-driven architecture, microservices, and cloud concepts (AWS/Azure)

**Desired Skills:** Ideal candidates for this position should possess some or all of the following skills:
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to make sound and timely decisions, to consistently deliver on commitments, and assume responsibility for results
* Ability to think creatively and meet challenges with resourcefulness
* Ability to prioritize competing demands and effectively manage multiple tasks and/or projects
* Exceptional verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to apply common sense to carry out instructions and instruct others, train personnel, write procedures and correspondence, speak clearly to clients and associates
* Take initiative to research and resolve problems prior to asking for assistance from Manager

**Work Environment:**  
We are a culture that believes that people are our greatest asset and are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in bringing clarity and simplicity to our associates (employees) and clients. Our decisions are made efficiently, fairly, and locally. Our success is directly tied to the communities we serve. It is equally important for us to look through the lens of our applicants and associates to identify their individual needs. As such, we want to share the following:
  

* We are committed to our core value of meritocracy and supporting our associates in growing within their role
* When completing certain tasks, an associate may need to be able to grasp, push, pull, lift, bend, raise and hold hands and arms overhead.
* Traditional Monday – Friday hours. Either 8am-5pm or 9am-6pm shift. 40 hours a week.
* Must be able to work at a rapid pace while sitting for long periods
